items.title: Loop to the start
items.say: One. Loop to the start, so the ending flows into the first second.

items.title: Cut mid-laugh
items.say: Two. Cut mid-laugh. Never wait for the silence.

items.title: End on a question
items.say: Three. End on a question viewers want to answer.

caption: Endings matter too 🔚 Save this for your next edit.
